summary: Compact cycling choice control with a vertical position indicator.
useWhen: Two or three local view modes should cycle through one compact button without opening a popup.
The current choice should update its label and/or icon while a small vertical dot indicator shows its position.
avoidWhen: The full choice set must remain visible at once; use TabGroup instead.
The user must inspect or search more than three options; use Select instead.
The value must participate in native form submission; this initial component is a local cycling control, not a form-associated select.

alternatives.when: Every choice should be visible and individually selectable.
alternatives.reason: TabGroup exposes all choices and owns segmented keyboard selection.

alternatives.when: The option list exceeds three choices or needs a dropdown.
alternatives.reason: Select provides a popup and the complete form-select contract.

accessibility: A single native button owns focus and activation by pointer, Enter, or Space; the dots are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
Each option supplies a nonempty label, including icon-only choices. The button name announces the current label, position, and next choice; aria-label adds stable context.
An inactive button is natively disabled. Do not use aria-pressed because this is a multi-choice cycle, not a binary toggle.
states: The application supplies exactly two or three uniquely valued options and may set value; invalid values resolve to the first choice without emitting a user-change event.
Activation advances to the next choice, wraps after the last, updates the mutable value, and emits dsChange once with the next value.
Variant selects label, icon, or icon-label content; the trailing slot scales with control density and displays the same number of vertical dots as choices.
Both treatments use transparent unfilled chrome; hasBorder removes only the inset stroke while preserving control geometry.
responsiveBehavior: Hug follows the current content; fill uses the parent width and truncates a long label without moving the trailing indicator.

When collapseLabel is enabled in a table caption or data toolbar narrower than 900px, icon-label choices display only the icon while preserving the changing accessible name. Explicit icon and label variants are unchanged.
Small, medium, and large use shared control-density heights and matching dot-slot geometry.

customElements: Assign options as a JavaScript property and listen for dsChange to observe user cycling.
react: Pass options as an array and handle onDsChange to observe user cycling.
vue: Bind options as an array and handle dsChange to update application state.
angular: Bind options as an array and handle dsChange to update application state.

styling.rationale: The component owns one density-sized unfilled button, changing choice content, and a fixed trailing position indicator; applications own surrounding layout and the choice data.

protected.reason: Control density and the indicator slot stay aligned across the supported variants.
